title: CPSC Recalls (SaferProducts.gov REST API)
channel: US Consumer Product Safety Commission
notes: Signal stream — recall activity for product categories we cover. Not a regulation text source; evidence-only (no regulation_id mapping). Items sorted by (RecallDate, RecallNumber) so API re-ordering does not read as a content change. Replaced the CPSC Newsroom RSS feed on 2026-09-17: cpsc.gov/Newsroom/RSS/Recalls answered HTTP 403 to every automated client tested from the production host (Chrome UA, full fallback header set, and plain curl alike), so the source had been failing on every pass since it was added. The RestWebServices endpoint serves the same recalls as JSON with no key and no challenge.
why_added: US CPSC recall announcements — early warning for product-safety incidents affecting our covered categories.

MARKED UNREACHABLE 2026-09-17: the JSON API this entry pointed at (ec.europa.eu/safety-gate-alerts/api/v1/notifs) now answers HTTP 404, and every candidate replacement probed from the production host returns the SPA shell as text/html rather than JSON — /screen/api/v1/notifs, /screen/webReport/api/v1/notifs, /public/api/notifs/, /public/api/menu/list/ all do.
